answer.reason: The "picture tiles" section on the site is the Bento Section component (home page, contentId 27), whose description is literally "Shows a subheading, heading, and a list of 'Bento' cards. A great way to showcase some screenshots or graphics." It renders a bento-box style grid of image tiles (varying sizes, including large ones) via a nested LinkedContentNestedGrid field (BentoCards) pointing to the BentoCard content model. Each tile is one BentoCard item with Eyebrow, Title, Description, and a Graphic (ImageAttachment) field — exactly matching "a new tile with a large product screenshot." No Gallery/GalleryImage, Feature Grid, or other model better fits the "tile" framing or the screenshot-showcase use case described for this model. So the new tile's content should be created as a new BentoCard item (added to the existing BentoSection's BentoCards grid), not a new content model.
